PART I

Item 1. Business

ACME Chips designs graphics processors for data centers. Our wafers are manufactured by Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited, or TSMC, which is our sole foundry.

Customer A accounted for 14% of our revenue in fiscal year 2025. Our competitors include NVIDIA and Advanced Micro Devices.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

We depend on a single foundry for all of our wafers.

Export controls may restrict our sales of data center products to China.

Our gross margin could decline if HBM memory prices rise.

A cybersecurity incident could disrupt our operations.

Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition
